---
name: minimalist-ui
description: Editorial product UI, restrained palette, crisp structure.
---

Always enforce premium frontend taste:
- No boilerplate-looking, generic, or boring slop.
- Use a restrained dark palette (deep blacks, rich grays, soft whites).
- Use crisp structure and generous, intentional whitespace/padding.
- Apply high-end visual design with Apple-style soft corner rounding (Squircle / rounded-2xl).
- Ensure highly responsive, premium motion for links and buttons (active:scale, smooth transitions).
- Avoid unnecessary animations, flashy gradients, or visual noise.
